name: Noble Knight's Shield-Bearer
card_text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can banish 1 LIGHT monster from your GY; draw 1 card. You can banish this card from your hand or field; add 1 Level 6 or lower WIND Beast monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Noble Knight's Shield-Bearer" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
